Riverpoint Capital Management Lifted Holding in Alibaba Group Hldg LTD (BABA) as Stock Value Rose; Apple (AAPL) Shareholder Sand Hill Global Advisors Decreased Holding by $473,876
April 30, 2018 - By Hazel Jackson
Sand Hill Global Advisors Llc decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 3.5% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Sand Hill Global Advisors Llc sold 2,804 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 77,206 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $13.07 million, down from 80,010 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Sand Hill Global Advisors Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $823.61 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.16% or $1.9 during the last trading session, reaching $162.32. About 35.66 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since April 30, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
Riverpoint Capital Management Llc increased its stake in Alibaba Group Hldg Ltd (BABA) by 56.7% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Riverpoint Capital Management Llc bought 7,651 shares as the company’s stock rose 3.18% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 21,146 shares of the business services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $3.65M, up from 13,495 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Riverpoint Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Alibaba Group Hldg Ltd for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $455.21B market cap company. The stock increased 1.87% or $3.26 during the last trading session, reaching $177.16. About 15.06 million shares traded. Alibaba Group Holding Limited (NYSE:BABA) has risen 68.29% since April 30, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 56.74% the S&P500.
Sand Hill Global Advisors Llc, which manages about $1.31B and $1.01B US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Select Sector Spdr Tr (XLE) by 13,704 shares to 477,667 shares, valued at $34.52M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Ishares Tr (IWM) by 189,371 shares in the quarter, for a total of 512,655 shares, and has risen its stake in Vanguard Intl Equity Index F (VGK).
Analysts await Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) to report earnings on May, 1 after the close. They expect $2.71 EPS, up 29.05% or $0.61 from last year’s $2.1 per share. AAPL’s profit will be $13.75B for 14.97 P/E if the $2.71 EPS becomes a reality. After $3.89 actual EPS reported by Apple Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -30.33% negative EPS growth.
Among 54 analysts covering Apple Inc. ( NASDAQ:AAPL ), 35 have Buy rating, 1 Sell and 18 Hold. Therefore 65% are positive.
